decision.reason: The release note [ev-c4d7d1a131dd] is only a title. The linked PR [ev-616e0063de22] adds that EC2NodeClass conversion now succeeds for unpinned Ubuntu NodeClasses, which moves the failure from conversion time to NodeClass readiness. That gives a subject, a change and roughly a consequence. However, nothing shown defines what makes a NodeClass "unpinned Ubuntu" (which field or value), so no applicability condition can be written. It also doesn't say what an operator must do to make the NodeClass ready. The PR changed the v1 migration guide and the nodeclasses docs [ev-07f25ad7a80c], which likely hold this, but their content isn't shown. That section or the conversion diff is needed.
